citations.quote:
[name="娜汀"]你的运气真的很好，厄尔苏拉军令长。
[name="娜汀"]弄丢了至关重要的战争装备，被叛军俘虏后，还能全须全尾地回来的情况并不常见。
[name="娜汀"]同为疤痕商场的佣兵，你和他们处得很好啊。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]闭嘴小食腐者，还轮不到你来评判我的失败。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_404_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="曼弗雷德"]不管怎么样，厄尔苏拉军令长的存活对于军事委员会来说都是一个好消息。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]曼弗雷德将军，我——
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_404_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="曼弗雷德"]血魔大君的殒没我已知晓，解释的话可以之后再说。
[name="曼弗雷德"]但我希望你出现在这里，是带着有价值的东西。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]我带回了骸骨的位置……还有留守骸骨的佣兵的具体情况。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1333_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="娜汀"]就这？听上去你留在那些雇佣兵手里还更有价值一点。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_404_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="曼弗雷德"]我想听听你的想法。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]巨兽骸骨无法启动，那群佣兵正在想方设法让它重启。他们接下来的打算，应该也离不开那个东西。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]我不清楚这伙雇佣兵的具体计划，但是不知为什么，他们留守骸骨的人似乎并不多。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_404_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="曼弗雷德"]赫德雷，也在其中？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]……是。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_404_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="曼弗雷德"]……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_404_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="曼弗雷德"]传令，包围这片峡谷。
[name="曼弗雷德"]不惜一切代价，立刻夺回脊椎。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1333_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="娜汀"]是！
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]曼弗雷德将军，接下来的战斗——
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_404_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="曼弗雷德"]你不用参与，留在后方。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]明白……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]将军……以防万一，我还是想请示一下。
[name="厄尔苏拉"]如果敌人抵抗激烈，我们迟迟夺不下骸骨，又该怎么办？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_404_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="曼弗雷德"]……
[name="曼弗雷德"]我不喜欢听到这种假设，厄尔苏拉。

contributions.description: 曼弗雷德与厄尔苏拉具名直接对话、汇报。

citations.quote:
[name="厄尔苏拉"]两位王庭之主在这里全力搏杀，还有，“魔王”。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1067_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]……
[name="厄尔苏拉"]这里绝不再是总能逃出战争的你们，能够活下来的地方了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]那么，你呢？
[name="赫德雷"]特雷西斯在伦蒂尼姆的最终手段，你是不是早就有所耳闻？
[name="赫德雷"]即使……那些东西带来的后果可能远超常识？你仍旧觉得，在这样的代价之上重建卡兹戴尔，对萨卡兹是有益的？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1067_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]……
[name="厄尔苏拉"]……不用废话了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1067_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]士兵们，趁还有时间，把他们了结在这里。
[Dialog]
[Charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_underwateramb", channel="bld", loop=true,volume=0.5)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_419_1#1$1",focus="all")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_419_1#1$1",focus="all")]
[name="脊椎守卫"]少校，你看。
[name="脊椎守卫"]这里的骨头上……
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="鲜血正沿着所有的骨头，匍匐爬行而来。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n鲜血正填充这里，溢满这些破损的空隙，连接这具冰冷已久的身体。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1067_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]是血魔大君阁下。
[name="厄尔苏拉"]看来他已经准备好了。
[Dialog]
[Charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_erthshkng",loop=true,channel="sk",volume=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_bone_rub", volume=0.9)]
[CameraShake(duration=3, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[StopSound(channel="bld", fadetime=5)]
[StopSound(channel="sk", fadetime=5)]
[Delay(time=3)]
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="它……正在温暖起来。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n骨骼中再次积蓄起力量，脊椎左右摇动，吱呀作响。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n这只巨兽重新开始了游动。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]……这么多的血。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]厄尔苏拉，这些血，是从哪里来的？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_412_1#13$1",focus="m")]
[name="W"]这还用说，是他们那位杀人成瘾的血魔大君，把这里屠了个干净。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4087_ines_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="伊内丝"]不，他们的手腕……
[stopmusic(fadetime=1.5)]
[Dialog]
[Charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$blooddrop")]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_blood",delay=2)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="厄尔苏拉和她的部下们，手腕上都有一道还在滴着血的伤口。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n滴答，滴答，一开始只是血珠，后来则是血的丝带，血的河流。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n一个人的身体里到底有多少血？",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n守卫们身体中淌出的血，与白骨上正蔓延的血痕连接在了一起。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_erthshkng",loop=true,channel="sk",volume=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=3, xstrength=8, ystrength=6, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=false, block=false)]
[StopSound(channel="sk", fadetime=5)]
[Delay(time=4.5)]
[playMusic(intro="$katzdale_intro", key="$katzdale_loop", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_419_1#1$1",focus="all")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_419_1#1$1",focus="all")]
[name="脊椎守卫"]“我将我的血奉献给您，鲜血王庭的主人。”
[name="脊椎守卫"]“愿您的猎杀无往不利。”
[Dialog]
[Charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1067_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]“而我们的血，将为您架起，奔腾的车舆。”
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4087_ines_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="伊内丝"]厄尔苏拉！停下！你疯了吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]这只巨兽……它正准备游动！
[name="赫德雷"]我们现在的位置，会被那些历史的乱流卷走！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_412_1#11$1",focus="m")]
[name="W"]这女人想和我们同归于尽——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1067_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]我没有在操纵它。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4087_ines_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="伊内丝"]——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1067_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]鲜血取代了肌肉，取代了韧带，取代了骨髓。
[name="厄尔苏拉"]它们还不够操纵它的吗？
[Dialog]
[Charslot]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="守卫们裸露在外的皮肤肉眼可见地苍白下去。厄尔苏拉的脸色也越来越差。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n终于，流淌停止了。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_bodyfallvalley", volume=1)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="萨卡兹的军人们会为主君奉献一切，何止于血。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n他们的皮肤干瘪下去，他们终于倒下。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1067_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]好伙计们，你们是陪我到最后的人了，我们会在众魂间相会。
[name="厄尔苏拉"]我说了，这具骸骨，不再是想要逃开的人，能够活下来的地方了。
[charslot]
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_erthshkng",loop=true,channel="sk",volume=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=3, xstrength=8, ystrength=6, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=false, block=false)]
[StopSound(channel="sk", fadetime=5)]
[Delay(time=4.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]快点！我们得先躲到舱室里！
[name="赫德雷"]幻境已经开始浮现，我们不知道它会前往哪里！
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=8, ystrength=6, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Delay(time=1.2)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_watersubcreate",volume=0.8)]
[CameraShake(duration=3, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Delay(time=3)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]——它掀起了浪！注意！
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_watermagic_2", volume=0.6)]
[stopmusic(fadetime=2.5)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=3, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Background(image="43_g1_giantmonstercockpit", screenadapt="coverall", block=true)]
[delay(time=2)]
[playMusic(key="$formal_loop", volume=0.6)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_runstop")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.7, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_412_1#2$1",duration=0.5)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4087_ines_1#13$1",duration=0.5)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4087_ines_1#13$1",focus="r")]
[name="伊内丝"]啧，那血魔要把我们带去哪里？
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_412_1#2$1",focus="l")]
[name="W"]赫德雷呢？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[name="赫德雷"]我在这儿。还有她。
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",duration=1)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]失血过多，能不能活下来看她本事了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="n")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]你们大可把我留在舱室外，赫德雷，我宁愿和我的部下们死在一起。
[name="厄尔苏拉"]你们干掉的“老相识”这么多，不会今天突然就发了善心。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]你还有用。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="n")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]我说了，这具骸骨已经脱离了我的掌控。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]你也说了，你忠于军事委员会。
[name="赫德雷"]如果你认为军事委员会，会是卡兹戴尔作为一个“国家”的依仗……那为什么，那个人还以摄政王自称？
[name="赫德雷"]为什么他还需要特蕾西娅？为什么他会觉得，打赢这场仗，卡兹戴尔就能有未来？
[name="赫德雷"]特雷西斯到底在想什么？
[charslot(slot="n",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#7$1",focus="n")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]算了，这些，等我们拿下这只巨兽后再谈吧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="n")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]你们……要去做什么？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]我们的目的从未改变。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]回家。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="n")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]……呵。“回家”。
[name="厄尔苏拉"]这本来就是这具骸骨最后的任务。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]……什么？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#4$1",focus="n")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]它有一个名字，它的代号是“生命脊椎”。
[name="厄尔苏拉"]虽然很少被使用，但是曼弗雷德将军定下这个名字的时候……也和我说过和你一样的话。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]一样的话？曼弗雷德他……
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]我们是敌人，我不会回答更多问题，我只等待我的死亡。
[name="厄尔苏拉"]再说，呵，你活到今天本身就是一种答案。
[name="厄尔苏拉"]真当曼弗雷德将军是个睁眼瞎？一点看不出你们的小伎俩？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4087_ines_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="伊内丝"]……
[Dialog]
[Charslot]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]不过，那也得等你们从血魔大君的手下活着离开后，才有资格继续谈论“回家”。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]说的没错。

directions.reason: 曼弗雷德曾亲自命名生命脊椎并向厄尔苏拉说明“回家”。
厄尔苏拉明确回顾曼弗雷德命名与识破行动。
